---
name: Bug report
about: Report a software error.
title: "[Bug] "
---

## Problem

What did you run, what happened, and what did you expect?

## Steps to reproduce

Include the command, model variant and relevant configuration. Use a small synthetic fixture if the example needs inputs.

## Environment and logs

Include the commit or release and the relevant output from `python check_environment.py --device cpu` or `--device cuda`. Copy the relevant exception and remove credentials, private paths and licensed data before posting.
